dq_cr_no_cold: no cold pressure to compute the build-up
dq_cd_missing: Channel not present in the file.
dq_cd_constant: Constant value ({value}) over the whole session: the sensor is not being logged.
dq_cd_constant_ambient: Constant at {value}, equal to the ambient temperature: the simulator is not modelling it.
dq_cd_synth_clock: Synthesized by integrating Speed over the '{clock}' clock ({hz} Hz). Lap-length repeatability {prec} over {n} laps.
dq_cd_synth_clock_noprec: Synthesized by integrating Speed over the '{clock}' clock ({hz} Hz). Precision could not be estimated (fewer than 3 comparable laps).
dq_cd_synth_noclock: Synthesized by integrating Speed assuming a fixed 100 Hz, because the file has no usable time channel. Precision unknown.
dq_cd_wear_inactive: Tyre wear is disabled in the simulator ({evidence}).
dq_cd_wear_unknown: No tyre wear / rubber grip channel in the file.
dq_r_geometry_no_coords: No position coordinates: the track layout is rebuilt from yaw rate / steering and is less precise.
dq_r_geometry_none: No position, yaw rate or steering channel to reconstruct the track.
dq_r_delta_synth: Distance is synthesized ({prec}): lap alignment and the delta along the lap are less reliable.
dq_r_delta_no_distance: No distance channel to align the laps.
dq_r_gg_estimated: No lateral / longitudinal G channels: G forces are estimated from kinematics (less reliable).
dq_r_gg_missing: No lateral / longitudinal G channels and no position data to estimate them.
dq_r_gg_partial: Missing {missing}: the G-G diagram is incomplete.
dq_r_dyn_missing: Needs steering angle and lateral G (missing: {missing}).
dq_r_dyn_no_yaw: Yaw rate not logged: balance is inferred from steering and lateral G only.
dq_r_slip_missing: Slip angle needs lateral G and yaw rate (missing: {missing}).
dq_r_slip_no_steer: Without steering angle only the body slip angle is computed (no axle slip angles).
dq_r_susp_partial: Only {n} of 4 suspension channels present: pitch / roll metrics are less reliable.
dq_r_susp_invalid: Suspension channels are constant or empty.
dq_r_tyre_temp_partial: Only {n} of 4 corners have tyre temperature.
dq_r_tyre_temp_constant: Tyre temperatures are constant, so no thermal analysis is possible.
dq_r_tyre_wear_inactive: Tyre wear is disabled in the simulator ({evidence}): degradation cannot be separated from fuel burn and track evolution.
dq_r_tyre_wear_few_laps: Needs at least {min} valid laps for the degradation trend (found {n}).
dq_r_tyre_wear_unknown: No tyre wear channel: degradation is inferred only from lap times and thermal stress.
dq_r_brake_no_long_g: Brake efficiency needs longitudinal G, which is not logged.
dq_r_brake_temp_constant: Brake temperatures are constant ({value}): temperature-based fade cannot be evaluated; efficiency uses Brake and G only.
dq_r_brake_temp_missing: Brake temperatures not logged: temperature-based fade cannot be evaluated; efficiency uses Brake and G only.
dq_r_fuel_missing: Fuel level not logged: consumption and pit window are unavailable; only the lap-time trend works.
dq_r_fuel_constant: Fuel level is constant (not being logged): consumption and pit window are unavailable.
dq_r_fuel_few_laps: Only {n} valid laps ({min}+ recommended): the consumption estimate is weak.
dq_r_thermal_none: No thermal channel is usable (water, oil, brake temperatures, tyre pressure, brake bias).
dq_r_setup_depends: Depends on the corner and telemetry analyses, which have no data.
dq_r_setup_few: Only {n} of {total} supporting analyses have data: recommendations cover part of the car.
dq_r_rl_few_laps: The learned line is weak with only {n} valid laps ({min}+ recommended).
dq_r_optimal_synth: Distance is synthesized ({prec}): sector / corner matching between laps is approximate.
dq_r_module_unavailable: The module returned no result with the available data.
dq_fix_generic: Include {channel} in the export (ACTI / MoTeC) to improve the analysis.
dq_fix_distance: Export the Distance channel (ACTI: add 'Distance'; MoTeC: 'Lap Distance') so laps align by real distance instead of an integrated estimate.
dq_fix_lap_counter: Log the lap counter (Session Lap Count) so laps are segmented exactly instead of by distance resets.
dq_fix_steer: Log the steering angle: it is needed for balance and slip-angle analysis.
dq_fix_lat_g: Log lateral G (ACTI / MoTeC channel 'G Lat'): it drives the G-G diagram, balance and slip angle.
dq_fix_long_g: Log longitudinal G (channel 'G Long'): it drives the G-G diagram and braking efficiency.
dq_fix_yaw: Add the yaw rate channel to enable slip angle and a more reliable under/oversteer balance.
dq_fix_position: Log the car position channels (Car Coord X / Y) for exact track geometry and corner detection.
dq_fix_tyre_temp: Log tyre temperatures (core / inner / middle / outer) for all four corners.
dq_fix_tyre_press_hot: Enable the four tyre pressure channels in the ACTI / MoTeC export.
dq_fix_tyre_press_cold: Enable the cold tyre pressure (setup) channels in the export so the pressure build-up (hot minus cold) and its recommendations can be computed.
dq_fix_susp: Log the four suspension travel channels.
dq_fix_brake_temp: Enable brake disc temperature logging, or use a car that models it: a fixed value hides fade and cooling issues.
dq_fix_water: Enable the coolant temperature channel in the export.
dq_fix_oil: Enable the oil temperature channel in the export.
dq_fix_fuel: Log the fuel level channel to obtain consumption per lap and the pit window.
dq_fix_tyre_wear: Enable tyre wear in the simulator (Assetto Corsa: Assists > Tyre wear) and record a session of 5 or more laps; otherwise degradation cannot be measured.
dq_fix_in_pit: Log the In Pit channel to detect pit laps automatically.
dq_fix_ambient: Log air / road temperature to put tyre and brake temperatures in context.
dq_fix_more_laps: Only {n} valid laps found. Record at least {min} consecutive clean laps (no pit stops) to unlock the trend, degradation and racing-line models.
